tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services: marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API with JWT-based authentication using httpOnly cookies.

kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer - Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack experience, I bring hands-on knowledge of building scalable web applications using the MERN stack. During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which was taken live for real customer bookings. Additionally, I implemented role-based access control and designed an admin dashboard. In my project work, I developed Zenvest, a stock trading platform clone, utilizing Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React-related concepts, implementing JWT authentication and Joi-based request validation. I also built StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property listing platform using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. My background aligns well with the requirements for hands-on knowledge in JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, and SQL/MongoDB. I am eager to contribute my technical skills to your engineering team through this internship opportunity. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
